reason: With 950 members and 1.8 million in turnover I can't put the whole club's administration on two founders whose first pilot isn't even live yet. I also see nothing here that brings in more green fee, buggy, lesson or sponsor revenue. It's mostly an app with our logo on it.
objection: What happens to our member data, invoices and tee sheet if those two founders stop or one of them gets sick? I have no exit plan, no escrow and no reference club that has run a full season on it.
would_change_my_mind: A comparable 18-hole club that has run a full season on it live, plus a written guarantee that we get a full export of all our data and a transition period if they stop.
